svg.title: Velocity components of a projectile
svg.desc: (a) A projectile launched at θ0 above the horizontal: at each instant its velocity v has a constant horizontal component vx and a vertical component vy that shrinks to zero at the top and then grows downward; it returns to launch height with vy = −v0y and θ = −θ0. (b) The horizontal motion alone: the same vx at every step. (c) The vertical motion alone: vy decreases on the way up and increases on the way down. (d) Adding vx and vy gives v at angle θ below the horizontal.
